posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
Wow! Gen Con just happened! That is such an incredibly busy and work intensive show. This year we all went *into* the show exhausted after shipping around 4000 OblivAon parcels, but that can't be helped. We also received a ton of other stuff. Here's a look at some of the things we did in the past month:

  • Maggie and Chris Kirkman attended Dice Tower Con.
  • Christopher attended Con in the Castle and Geekly Con.
  • We all went to Gen Con.
  • Jenn and the graphic design department designed and printed a ton of things for Gen Con.
  • Chris Burton, Twuana, and SaRae assembled a ton of prototype games.
  • Jenn, Sarah, SaRae, and Maggie made a ton of decorations for the Gen Con party on Thursday night.
  • Trevor moved to St. Louis and started full time!
  • We finished the first season of Sentinel Comics LIVE on Twitch.
  • Jodie, Matt, and the warehouse team moved 150% of the maximum capacity of our warehouse through our warehouse while it was already 120% full.
  • Matt worked to improve Gen Con organization and setup/teardown.
  • Alex and I standardized our terms for warehousing and fulfillment for other publishers.
  • Craig got a new kilt.

Here is the status of all of our works in progress. There are a ton of changes!

In Stock Since July

  1. New Bedford reprint
  2. SotM: Shattered Timelines & Wrath of the Cosmos reprint
  3. Spirit Island promo spirits
  4. Sentinel Comics RPG: Stolen Legacy

Shipping to Backers

  1. The OblivAeon stuff for European fulfillment
  2. SotM: OblivAeon
  3. SotM: Stuntman, Benchmark, & Void Guard
  4. SotM: Complete Hero Variant Collection
  5. SotM: Ultimate Collector's Case
  6. SotM: 5th Anniversary Foil Villain Collection
  7. SotM: Promo Cards
  8. The giant OblivAeon KS shipping cartons.

In Transit; On A Boat

 

  1. More OblivAeon Stuff
  2. Spirit Island (even even more)
  3. Spirit Island: Branch & Claw reprint
  4. Spirit Island: Promo Spirit Pack reprint
  5. Compounded reprint
  6. Bottom of the 9th mini-expansion reprint

At Factory; Pre-Press Work

  1. Legend of Sleepy Hollow

Current WIP Focus by GTG

  1. Sentinel Comics: The Role Playing Game core rulebook (Christopher, Jenn, Critical Hits)
  2. Prime War (Christopher, Chris Burton, Lore Forge)
  3. Spirit Island expansion (Paul, Christopher, Jenn, Erik)
  4. Sentinels of Freedom video game (Christopher, Adam, Underbite Studio)
  5. The History of Sentinel Comics (Christopher, Adam)
  6. Fate of the Elder Gods: Agents of Arkham (Chris Kirkman)
  7. Homebrewers (Chris Kirkman, Chris Burton, SaRae)
  8. Some other games (Chris Kirkman, Chris Burton)
  9. A new and improved website (Jenn, Paul, Alex, Joel)

I'll see you next month!
